entries.summary: A Windows service failed to start. Check the service name and its related application before changing its startup settings.
A service dependency failed. Check the dependent service and its prerequisites; do not change services automatically.
A service timed out while starting. Check recent software changes and the service-specific event details.
Windows reported a bad block. Back up important data and check the storage device; do not run repairs before protecting data.
A storage I/O operation reported an error. Check device health, cables, and backups before attempting repairs.
A storage operation was retried. Check drive health and connection stability; repeated events need investigation.
A file-system structure error was reported. Back up important data and seek a planned disk check; no disk repair is started automatically.
Windows restarted without a clean shutdown. This event does not identify the root cause; check power, overheating, and nearby error events.
This event is commonly benign. Do not edit DCOM permissions or the registry based on this event alone.
An application crashed. Check the affected application and nearby Windows Error Reporting events; update or repair only that application.
Windows recorded an application or system failure report. Use its report details to identify the affected component.
